subject: Staged step-up: 16→32 reserved GPUs — phased pricing & throughput guardrails
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <c.park@cumulustech.com>, CumulusTech Procurement <procurement@cumulustech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: phased 16→32 reserved step-up + throughput guardrails (draft)

Claire — following our call this morning, attached is a compact staged plan for CumulusTech's renewal. Key points up front:

- Objective: double reserved capacity (16→32 GPUs) at renewal with controlled spend and a 60-day ramp to validate throughput and autoscaling behavior.
- Billing: blended hourly reserved rate across stage 1 (16 GPUs retained) and stage 2 (additional 16 GPUs) with proration for the first invoice period.
- Throughput guarantee: we propose a 99th-percentile per-request latency SLO for the primary workload and a baseline throughput floor during stage 2 while we complete kernel tuning.
- Fallbacks: automatic route to GPU burst pool for sustained spikes; SLA credit formula described in attached terms.

Attachments: capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (stage schedule + hourly blended pricing), redwood-reserved-terms.pdf (terms excerpt, proposed SLA language).

Request: can you confirm the desired effective date (renewal date) and whether Procurement wants pricing split across two POs (one for baseline 16, one for add-on 16) or a single contract amendment? If you prefer, we can present a 30-day pilot for the additional 16 GPUs at the same blended rate as a validation step.

I copied Lauren (sales ops) & Connor (solutions) to help scope the throughput guardrails and final pricing.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0136
From: Claire Park <c.park@cumulustech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: CumulusTech Procurement <procurement@cumulustech.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased 16→32 reserved step-up + throughput guardrails (draft)

Thanks Jordan — review notes from Product + Procurement below. Short answers first: renewal date stays 2027-08-01; Procurement prefers a single contract amendment (simpler for finance).

Product questions (from my engineering lead):
- Can you confirm the 99th pctl latency target is measured at the customer edge (post-proxy) or only at the Redwood egress? We need end-to-end SLA guarantees for our internal SLOs.
- During the 60-day ramp, will you commit to an on-call tuning window (SRE pairing) if we see KV-cache thrashing on our larger seq lengths?

Procurement items:
- We need a clearer definition of proration calculations for the first invoice period — show example math for Aug invoice if stage 2 goes live mid-month.
- Please include standard cybersecurity appendices and confirm SOC 2 scope for the Dedicated pool.

Also: would you be open to a 90-day commercial trial for the additional 16 GPUs at 75% of the blended reserved hourly rate, converting to the final rate upon successful throughput acceptance? That helps our budget committee greenlight the add-on faster.

-Claire

On Mon, Jun 28, 2027 at 9:14 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claire — following our call this morning, attached is a compact staged plan for CumulusTech's renewal...
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <c.park@cumulustech.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased 16→32 reserved step-up + throughput guardrails (draft)

Claire — looping in pricing & billing math. Answers below and updated commercial options inline.

1) SLA measurement: Redwood measures at egress (our service edge) by default. For customers needing end-to-end measurement we can add an optional synthetic test harness that runs from your proxy to our edge; we'll log both vantage points and tie acceptance to the customer-observed test harness results. We'll add the harness to the SOW and include the test scripts in the capacity_plan_v2.xlsx tab 'acceptance_tests'.

2) SRE pairing: yes — Connor will be assigned a 4-week on-call pairing window immediately after stage 2 activation to tune kernel & cache settings. If major regressions are identified we will prioritize fix rollouts under our change freeze exception process.

3) Proration example (Aug invoice):
- Renewal effective 2027-08-01. Stage 2 (additional 16 GPUs) planned live date 2027-08-16 (mid-month).
- Invoice period Aug 1–Aug 31. Baseline charge for 16 GPUs billed full month at reserved rate. Additional 16 GPUs billed pro rata for 16/31 days at the blended reserved hourly rate described in the sheet. We will include line-level detail for audit.

4) Commercial trial: we can do a 60-day trial at 80% of the proposed blended reserved hourly rate (not 90 days at 75%). Rationale: we need a short validation window while keeping fiscal alignment. If acceptance criteria are met, charges for the trial period are credited toward the first full billing cycle at final rates.

Attached I included a short pricing extract and the amended SLA wording in redwood-reserved-terms.pdf. If Procurement needs SOC 2 evidence we can provide the latest report and control matrix — upload link in related_links.

Next steps: Jordan, can you confirm 1) whether Claire accepts a 60-day trial at 80% and 2) if Procurement agrees to a single amendment PO? If yes, I'll kick off the legal doc and route to DocuSign.

Thanks — Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Claire Park <c.park@cumulustech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: CumulusTech Procurement <procurement@cumulustech.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased 16→32 reserved step-up + throughput guardrails (draft)

Lauren / Jordan — we discussed internally and agree to the single amendment PO. We can accept the 60-day trial at 80% for the additional 16 GPUs, provided the acceptance harness is included in the SOW and the proration math is explicit on the invoice. Procurement will route the amendment for signature once Redwood confirms:

- exact live date for stage 2 (please assume 2027-08-16 pending final readiness check)
- Connor's on-call window and on-call contact details
- link to SOC 2 artifact (ok if behind an NDA portal)

If you can get those items into a contract draft by EOD Mon 2027-07-05 we can aim to sign the amendment by 2027-07-12 and make the August 16 activation.

I'll ask Procurement to open the PO once we receive the contract draft. Thanks for moving quickly.

— Claire
